title: SIP Mistake
description:
A single mistake in your SIP investment strategy could cost you around 4 to 5 lakhs over a decade
If this helped, subscribe for more India stories with real sources. Comment your take below.
A single mistake in your SIP investment strategy could cost you around 4 to 5 lakhs over a decade. This mistake occurs when investors pause their SIPs during market downturns due to loss aversion, disrupting the power of compounding and leading to significant losses. To avoid this, investors should understand the core mechanism of SIPs and have a long-term perspective, focusing on the bigger picture rather than short-term fluctuations.
